summary: the tick reports the trunk sha its last ship left, read under the ship lock once that ship's afterMerge gates passed and its ledger commit landed

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

acceptance: a tick that shipped reports a gatedTip on both the verdict and TickResult, equal to the trunk sha after its last ledger commit; a tick that shipped nothing reports none
tests: the tick verdict carries the gated trunk tip the tick's last ship left
gatedTip is absent on a tick that shipped nothing
TickResult carries the same gatedTip the verdict records
gatedTip names the tip after the last ledger commit of a multi-ship tick
notes: headSha is read without the ship lock and promises nothing about gating — the two are different facts and stay separate fields. A delivery step reads this instead of inferring a shipped tip from commit subjects.
